title: Laser Current
body:
Syntax: perform laser current <target>

Description: A Storm Release attack that strikes one target. A drained target loses Chakra over time.  Requires Storm Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 40-48. 25% chance to inflict drained. Unlocks at level 25. Costs 24 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
